commit_message: Implement Timeline loop boundaries and replay reconstruction
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body:
## ADR 0126 implementation

Current-main implementation of ADR 0126. This request restores exact loop-boundary event semantics and bounded forward-only ReplayRequired reconstruction with cancellation on top of the refreshed Timeline foundation.

The PR remains Draft until the full ADR Definition of Done and required Windows/Visual validation are complete.
